props.text: Try the Vertex demo for Modrix Commerce
Import the Vertex header, footer and six example pages, then change them in the page builder.

props.alt: Illustration of the Modrix Commerce admin and the demo import screen

props.text: Six example pages, plus a header and a footer
Importing the demo adds the header, the footer and these pages: Home, Features, Themes and modules, Use cases, Get started and Demo. Every one of them can be edited in the page builder.

props.label: Open Themes to import the demo

props.text:
php artisan cms:sync
php artisan cms:theme activate modrix/vertex --trust
# Then click 'Import demo' in Appearance -> Themes

props.label: Copy the commands
props.vertexCopy: php artisan cms:sync && php artisan cms:theme activate modrix/vertex --trust

props.text: Colors, fonts and buttons can be changed in Appearance → Theme settings. The hero color, the announcement strip, the footer stripe and the top link bar can be changed in Appearance → Customize.
